findings.detail: apply_key starts the asynchronous TUI worker; the test then ended and TemporaryDirectory cleanup could race with worker writes. Added the existing _wait_for_tui_idle synchronization before assertions.
test_agent relied on unittest.mock being imported as a side effect of another test. It now imports mock explicitly; the file runs successfully in isolation.

reviewed_evidence: Root cause from PR #2 run 41715676648: Linux Python 3.9 failed with TemporaryDirectory cleanup ENOTEMPTY after test_tui_real_terminal_enter_sends_but_raw_ctrl_j_does_not.
The target test applies the Enter key, which starts the asynchronous TUI worker. The test now waits for worker exit and busy=false before leaving the test body.
test_agent.py now imports mock explicitly; it no longer depends on another test having imported unittest.mock.
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_agent.py -v: 86 tests OK; target test passed; ruff E9/F passed; git diff --check passed.
unverified_scope: Only the local macOS CPython 3.13.9 test entry was run. Linux/Windows CI, the post-merge PR #2 tree, real providers, packaging/install, tags and Releases were not run. This is test-only maintenance and adds no product behavior.
